name: Zamuzh za tigra za 3 dnja
source:
One day he wanted to know what love is. And I decided that I wanted to help him. I was made for this.

But having met two beautiful tigers, will he be able to find his happiness?

Will he be able to find his own soul?

The only question is what happened to him?

[From [url=https://alexbrainhow.itch.io/makemehappydarling]Itch.io[/url]]
